verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP server exposes a broad set of mailbox operations that mirror core UI actions: reading and listing threads, composing and sending, drafts, deleting, marking read/unread, labels, bulk archive and delete, search, and AI compose and Q&A. However, nothing documents full UI-to-API parity, and authentication currently means copying a browser session cookie, with OAuth listed as 'coming soon'. missing for 10: documented parity claim or coverage of settings, multi-account and connection management, and UI customization via API; a general REST/public API reference; production-grade auth (OAuth); independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails
Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails
Get all user labels - Create new custom labels with custom colors - Delete existing labels
Search emails with custom queries - Filter emails by labels
You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
